title: eludite.forge.pull_checkout input
description: Check out a pull request's head locally: fetches `refs/pull/<n>/head` (GitHub, Forgejo, Gitea), `refs/merge-requests/<n>/head` (GitLab), the source branch (Azure DevOps), or the head branch from its repository (forks, Tangled) into the local branch `pr/<n>` (or `branch`) and checks it out as eludite.git.checkout does: a dirty working tree that the checkout would overwrite is refused with the paths. Execute (it changes the working tree; the policy's `execute` decides for an agent). The repository is the workspace's (its remote `origin`, or `remote`), detected as eludite.forge.detect does; every call runs on the forge worker off the UI thread with a timeout and stops when canceled. A call that needs a token when none is stored for the host fails with `sign_in_required: <host>`: the person signs in (Git > Sign in to <forge>); an agent cannot.

number.description: The number (GitHub, GitLab's `iid`, Azure DevOps, Forgejo, Gitea). Give `number` or `id`.

id.description: The item's `id` as a list answered it; Tangled's items have only this (their AT-URI). Give `number` or `id`.

remote.description: The git remote to read (default `origin`, else the only remote).
